description: This file defines the PaginationData class, a POJO used for managing pagination details such as page size, current page, offset, total count, and total pages in a web shop application.

classes.name: PaginationData
classes.description: A POJO representing pagination state, including page size, current page, offset, total count, and total pages, with methods to navigate between pages.

methods.name: PaginationData
methods.description: Constructor initializing pageSize and currentPage, throwing exception if pageSize is zero.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the number of results per page.

methods.name: getPageNumber
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current page number based on offset and pageSize.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Calculates and returns the offset for data retrieval based on currentPage and pageSize.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Creates a new PaginationData instance for the next page.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Creates a new PaginationData instance for the previous page.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of results.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of results.

methods.name: getTotalPages
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pages based on totalCount and pageSize.
